Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
brow...@boat.bt.com (Paul Brown) writes:

>The ?th (I can't remember the number) tradition : Accounting

Fourth Tradition.

>Or something along those lines, however it has confused me because it has a
>grey background like a master card, but has an action card symbol down the
>left hand side. Which is it ?

>A master card ?
>An action card ?
>or a weird Master Action card ?

It is an action card, requiring a Prince or Justicar (not an IC Member)
to take the action, and, if successful, the P/J will pay a blood for
the action.

The card is mis-printed with the 'Master' background.

Similarly, the Spawning Pool (A Master: Unique Location) is mis-printed
with the 'Minion' background, but is a master card nonetheless.

: grey background like a master card, but has an action card symbol down the
: left hand side. Which is it ?

: Paul Brown :)

The Fourth Tradition: Accounting is an action card. It was one of the
original set of misprints from Jyhad.

For those of you unfamiliar with it, the card is a Prince/Justicar +1
stealth action that costs a blood and puts up to 3 blood from the blood
bank on an uncontrolled vamp.

It's a superior Govern the Unaligned for Princes, Justicars.

I hope this helps

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
The Jyhad version of the Accounting is printed with the wrong border,
but is a minion card. When in doubt, remember that the border is
really just a reminder, and to help you organize your hand.
Jyhad's The Spawning Pool has the opposite error.
